name: Mullets
description: Mullets (Mugil cephalus, M. capurrii and Liza species) - the fish of the Imraguen sailboat fishery, migrating along the coast and grazing the Banc's seagrass and algae flats; in this model over 80% of their diet is algae and eelgrass, and more than 60% of their production comes from the Banc - the highest of any fish group. Functional group pooling the source's mullets compartment (several Mugil and Liza species measured together).
